title: Are there more bacteria in your body than human cells?
subtitle: Do bacteria outnumber your own cells ten to one? Guess, then watch the famous ratio shrink and learn why one trip to the toilet can tip it.
notes: bar_chart staged old (10:1) vs new (~1.3:1); animate ghost does not work on template bars, so the old bar is a hand-placed dashed outline (canvas coords read from frames).
